description: ED conducted searches at more than 10 locations in Mumbai, Chennai and Kochi; devices/documents were seized and bank funds were frozen.
ED arrested four Tamil Nadu-linked individuals described in the January 31 release.
ED published the Kerala Cluster Case release describing more than 400 mule accounts, ₹230.92 crore, and a remittance channel involving Nium India.
ED arrested Sayid Muhammad and Varghese T G under PMLA in connection with the case.
ED published a release describing approximately 500 mule accounts, ₹719 crore in credits, 26 WazirX-linked crypto accounts and ₹115.67 crore in cross-border crypto remittances.
Kerala High Court dismissed Sayid Muhammed's bail application; judgment records extensive prosecution allegations and investigation material.
